title: Unveiling Davydov-Split Excitons in a Template-Engineered Molecular-Graphene Heterostructure
summary: The realization of high-fidelity organic-inorganic quantum emulators is frequently hindered by the interfacial imperfections introduced during device fabrication. Here, we demonstrate a robust nanofabrication protocol that restores the atomic-scale purity of epitaxial graphene on SiC to UHV-equivalent levels, as confirmed by Low-Energy Electron Diffraction, and Microscopy.
